rootCause: reconstructFirstExecution compares resumeContext.briefingText (JSON.stringify at write time) with JSON.stringify(briefing) after the campaigns.input_snapshot JSONB round-trip. PostgreSQL JSONB returns object keys in a different order, so the strings differ although the content is semantically identical.
impact: Base step failed definitively before acquire/provider. No vertical, copy, thumbnail or provider call. Source campaign preserved. Target campaign is error and credit refunded once.
minimalNextDecision: Fix resumeContext.briefingText comparison to use canonical JSON (or persist/read canonical text) and then request a NEW authorization for a NEW operation; do not reuse this operation and do not retry under the current authorization.
